================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO RAU AFTER EFFECTS - YAM TSHIAB
Version 9.2.9  -  Lub Kaum Hli 2026
================================================================================

Muaj 33 ANIME THEMES tshiab ntxiv rau cov Demon Slayer, cov mouse effect ntawm cov theme
tam sim no tshwm tiag tiag hauv After Effects, thiab Theme Selector yog ib lub dropdown huv si xwb.

UA NTEJ KOJ PIB
- Nruab rau saum koj version tam sim no nrog koj lub ZXP installer li niaj zaus, ces rov pib dua
  After Effects ib zaug.
- Koj cov settings, theme, presets thiab expressions uas khaws cia tseem nyob.

TSHIAB: 33 ANIME THEMES
- Flex Settings > THEME SELECTOR > PANEL THEME tam sim no muaj ib pab rau txhua zaj anime:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan
  (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal
  Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu
  Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero
  Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) thiab Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- Txhua tus cim muaj nws tus kheej lub ntsej muag: yam uas caum koj lub mouse, qhov tawm tsam thaum
  koj nias ib lub khawm, yam tshwm sim thaum koj tuav lub khawm sab laug, thiab
  qhov tawg tom qab tuav li 2.5 vib nas this.
- Sib ib yam li cov Demon Slayer theme: cov effect tsuas khiav thaum koj
  txav mouse lossis nias xwb. Kaw AMBIENT EFFECTS kom khaws cov xim xwb.

HLOOV: THEME SELECTOR
- Cov Demon Slayer card hauv qab PANEL THEME tsis muaj lawm, yog li Flex Settings
  luv dua. Xaiv txhua lub theme ntawm PANEL THEME dropdown; nws qhib rau ntawm
  lub theme uas koj tab tom siv.
- Kurama thiab Baryon tam sim no nyob hauv pab Naruto.

KHO TAU
- Cov mouse effect ntawm cov theme (dej, nplaim taws, xob laim thiab lwm yam) feem ntau tsis
  tshwm hauv After Effects, txawm tias Optimised Mode kaw lawm los xij. Thaum panel nws tus kheej
  tab tom ua haujlwm ntau, thiab thaum pib uas ua haujlwm ntau, raug xav tias yog theme qeeb, yog li cov
  effect tua lawv tus kheej. Tam sim no, thaum koj lub graphics card kos lawv
  (feem ntau cov computer), cov sij hawm ntawd tsuas ua rau cov effect sib dua ib pliag xwb.

TSIS HLOOV
- Licensing, activation thiab txhua qhov link ua haujlwm ib yam li ua ntej.
- 11 lub Demon Slayer theme zoo ib yam li hauv 9.2.8.
- Txhua lub tab thiab cuab yeej lwm yam ua haujlwm ib yam li hauv 9.2.8.
================================================================================
